For Paper Map Printer and Technical Support roles, full CVs are not required. Tenderers should instead provide a short biographical summary for the personnel proposed, setting out their relevant experience, qualifications and/or training, proposed role and availability. Tenderers should also confirm the overall staffing capacity available within the relevant production and technical functions to support delivery of the contract. This approach will satisfy the the intent of the requirements of Award Criterion C & Annex A of the TRD. Not that this approach applies to all Lots under this Request for Tender nature. A project such as the Map Book may draw on a significant number of production staff across our business, each contributing to varying degrees — from a small, specific task through to substantial hands-on involvement — depending on production scheduling and volumes at the time. V poglavju Razlogi za izključitev in pogoji za sodelovanje je določeno, kateri pogoj mora v primeru skupne ponudbe izpolnjevati vsak izmed partnerjev oziroma, kateri pogoj lahko izpolnjujejo partnerji skupaj. V razmerju do naročnika, partnerji neomejeno solidarno odgovarjajo za pripravljeno ponudbo in izvedbo celotnega naročila. V primeru skupne ponudbe je potrebno v ponudbi predložiti pogodbo o skupnem nastopu. Iz pogodbe o skupnem nastopu mora biti razvidno sledeče: imenovanje nosilca posla pri izvedbi javnega naročila, pooblastilo nosilcu posla in odgovorni osebi za podpis ponudbe ter podpis pogodbe, izjava, da so vsi ponudniki v skupni ponudbi seznanjeni z navodili ponudnikom in razpisnimi pogoji ter merili za dodelitev javnega naročila in da z njimi v celoti soglašajo, izjava, da so vsi ponudniki seznanjeni s plačilnimi pogoji iz razpisne dokumentacije, določbe glede načina plačila preko nosilca posla, medsebojno odgovornost posameznih članov skupine za izvedbo naročila znotraj skupine, kateri posel vsak od partnerjev prevzema, navedba, da odgovarjajo naročniku za celotno obveznost in za vsak njen del vsi partnerji solid

ip_data_security.text: Če je zaupen samo določen podatek v dokumentu, mora biti tudi to jasno označeno. Pri poslovanju z javnim sektorjem so nekatere informacije javne, zato obstajajo izjeme od varovanja poslovne skrivnosti. Naročnik ne bo varoval zaupnosti podatkov, ki so javni na podlagi ZJN-3 oziroma na drugi pravni podlagi, ne glede na to, ali jih bo gospodarski subjekt označil kot poslovno skrivnost. Poslovne skrivnosti ne morejo predstavljati tudi podatki, ki so javni na podlagi prakse pristojnih organov. Vsi osebni podatki, ki bodo podani v ponudbi in njihova morebitna obdelava bo izvedena skladno z določili 6. člena Splošne uredbe EU o varstvu podatkov (GDPR, 2016/679) in bo potrebna zaradi izvedbe postopka oddaje javnega naročila skladno z ZJN-3. 11. Posredovanje podatkov naročniku Izbrani ponudnik mora na naročnikov poziv v postopku javnega naročanja v roku, ki ga bo določil naročnik posredovati podatke: svojih ustanoviteljih, družbenikih, delničarjih, komanditistih ali drugih lastnikih in podatke o lastniških deležih navedenih oseb; gospodarskih subjektih, za katere se glede na določbe zakona, ki ureja gospodarske družbe, šteje, da so z njim povezane družbe. 12. Even in an individual-rights model, employers are not external to the system. They are part of the governance environment in which relevance is interpreted, funding is sustained, and learning opportunities are aligned with labour market demand. This is why employer-relevant information matters to the success of ILA implementation. Employers are more likely to view ILAs as legitimate and useful when they can see signals of labour market relevance, meeting recognised standards, quality assurance, and system integrity. These signals do not require handing the scheme over to employers. But they do require that ILAs communicate value in ways employers can understand and can relate to. Section 3: Evidence Constraints and their Implications for Measurement 3.1. We have argued that employers are important to the success of ILAs. The next question is how much their role can actually be observed and measured. This is where a practical constraint becomes immediately clear. As we all know, ILAs are designed around the individual learner, the training entitlement, and the training opportunity. Consequently, the core platform data of

ning providers, learner surveys, provider surveys, awareness surveys, and qualitative interviews. The fact that provider surveys, awareness surveys and qualitative interviews appear as additional instruments is itself a sign that routine platform d ata are insufficient for many of the questions policymakers care about. c. A second difficulty is that some of the outcomes that matter most to employers lie beyond the immediate training event. The OECD report notes that learner surveys can measure satisfaction with the mechanism and the course, and that follow -up surveys can explore effects on jobs and careers (OECD, 2025a). But it also cautions that survey-based evidence is self-reported, can suffer from low response rates, and may be biased if satisfied learners are more likely to respond. For this reason, evidence on work -related outcomes derived from surveys needs to be treated carefully. It can be useful and policy -relevant, but it should not be presented as equivalent to robust causal evidence. 6 3.5. The potential gap between monitoring and impact: a. The distinction between monitoring and impact is essential. It can address three questions: (i) whether ILAs have the intended impact on the target population, (ii) whether that impact is achieved cost -effectively,
